entities.name: Sab-Sunen
entities.description: The frog-headed Amonkheti god of plenty, agriculture, irrigation, inspiration and fertility.

entities.name: Ketramose
entities.description: Amonkheti god to whom worship orders have coalesced alongside Sab-Sunen.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River whose waters run clear by Sab-Sunen's will.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City cleansed by the flooding Luxa.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after whose end the Luxa surged.

entities.name: Heqet
entities.description: Egyptian frog-headed goddess that may have inspired her.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the Luxa floods Naktamun, washing away blood, oil and machine corpses and cleansing the city.
At the height of the people's celebration Sab-Sunen finally appears.
Orders of worship to Sab-Sunen and Ketramose coalesce among the survivors, who raise new temples.
events.quote: Orders of worship to Sab-Sunen and Ketramose have coalesced among the survivors of Amonkhet
